timeline.body:
In https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/112063 we added support for multivalued fields to the compute engine for ST_INTERSECTS and relatives, but [not for ST_DISTANCE](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/112910). In https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/114729 it was discovered that, at least for the common case of a field and a constant, this support was not needed due to ST_DISTANCE being re-written to ST_INTERSECTS. However, for many other cases, like ST_DISTANCE used on the coordinator node, or between two fields, this lack of support would result in null values.

This PR fixes those cases, making sure ST_DISTANCE uses the Block-Builder approach similar to what was done for ST_INTERSECTS et al.

Fixes #112910

timeline.author: Craig Taverner
